title: Before They Break: GNWY on Mental Health, Purpose & Hope
summary: Jordan Miller and Stuart Bennett from Generation Why join Voices of OKC for a conversation about youth mental health, suicide prevention, anti-bullying, mentorship, creative arts, and purpose. Together with Jed Chappell, they talk about what it takes to reach students before they break, why young people need adults who listen before giving advice, and how purpose can help students see options beyond the obstacles in front of them.
